A two-step ritual built on a stylist principle: lift starts on damp hair, texture finishes dry. Boost is applied before the blow-dry to the root line to set lasting lift and volume. Full Effect layers on after styling to build instant body, separation, and fullness that holds.

Ideal For

Straight, wavy and curly hair with fine to medium texture.

    Always Safe For

    Color treated, chemically-treated, keratin treated and relaxed hair.

    How to Use

    On damp hair, use fingers to lift hair off the scalp and spray Boost directly onto the root line. Blow dry hair away from the scalp. Once styled, shake Full Effect well and spray liberally throughout dry hair to increase fullness and separation. Reapply as desired for maximum lift.

    Stylist tip: Full Effect is buildable. Layer in light passes for dimensional volume.

A two-step ritual built on a stylist principle: lift starts on damp hair, texture finishes dry. Boost is applied before the blow-dry to the root line to set lasting lift and volume. Full Effect layers on after styling to build instant body, separation, and fullness that holds.

Ideal For

Straight, wavy and curly hair with fine to medium texture.

    Always Safe For

    Color treated, chemically-treated, keratin treated and relaxed hair.

    How to Use

    On damp hair, use fingers to lift hair off the scalp and spray Boost directly onto the root line. Blow dry hair away from the scalp. Once styled, shake Full Effect well and spray liberally throughout dry hair to increase fullness and separation. Reapply as desired for maximum lift.

    Stylist tip: Full Effect is buildable. Layer in light passes for dimensional volume.
